general.desc: How WeruBWorker looks and behaves on this machine.
general.openAtLoginDesc: Launch WeruBWorker automatically when you sign in.
general.keepAwakeDesc: Prevent idle sleep so scheduled tasks fire on time.
general.runSetupDesc: Replays the first-run setup: model, first automation, tips.
general.trustedDesc: Trusted projects may manage their command allowances in .coworker/config.toml.
general.sidebarDesc: Longer lists collapse behind "Show more". Applies per coworker and per project.
general.filesDesc: Each conversation gets its own folder under this location. Existing conversations keep their current folder; you can grant access to more folders inside any conversation.
general.savedMsg: Saved. New conversations will use this location.
general.contextBarDesc: A small meter showing how full the model's context window is. Turn it off to show this session's token total instead; either way the full breakdown is one click away.
general.languageDesc: Select the display language for the interface
general.updateError: Couldn't check right now — try again later.
general.downloading: Downloading — WeruBWorker restarts by itself when it's ready.
general.noCommandAllowances: No project command allowances currently declared

models.title: Models
models.desc: Providers and the models offered in the composer's picker. Keys are stored only on this computer.
models.tokenSavingsDesc: PDF attachments travel with every turn of a conversation, so large documents multiply what you spend on tokens.
models.pdfFallback: PDFs on models without native PDF support
models.pdfFallbackDesc: Claude, GPT and Gemini read PDFs natively — this only applies to models that don't (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, local models…). Text extraction is cheapest; page images cost more tokens and need a vision-capable model.
models.pdfLimitDesc: PDFs over these limits are not attached — you'll see a notice in the composer instead.
models.compactionDesc: Long sessions are compacted automatically: older turns are summarized so the coworker keeps working instead of running out of context. Your visible transcript is never changed — a small marker shows where compaction happened.
models.capDesc: The cap makes very-large-context models compact early — quality and speed degrade well before their nominal limit.
models.summarizerDesc: The summary is written by this model. The default follows whatever model the session is using.
models.pickerDesc: The models offered when starting a session; the black badge marks the default.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.desc: Speak naturally in the composer. Recordings and transcripts stay on this device.
voice.subtitle: Speak instead of typing
voice.desktopOnly: Voice Input setup is available in the WeruBWorker desktop app.
voice.privateDesc: Audio is held in memory only while you record and is transcribed locally.
voice.micReady: Your microphone and local transcription engine are working.
voice.micSetup: Record a short phrase to enable the composer microphone.
voice.listening: ● Listening… speak a short phrase, then stop.
voice.deleteConfirm: Delete the local Whisper model and disable Voice Input?
voice.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try again and speak for a little longer.

personas.galleryDesc: Curated coworkers from the WeruBWorker team — see what each can do before installing.

onboarding.setupDesc: Pick a model provider to get started — WeruBWorker runs on your own key, and your key and your data stay on this computer.
onboarding.modelsNote: Models can be enabled or hidden anytime in Settings ▸ Models.
onboarding.connectToolsDesc: Chat can only advise. Connected, your coworker does the actual work:
onboarding.comingSoonGoogle: Coming soon — pending Google's app verification.
onboarding.signInDesc: WeruBWorker handles the OAuth for 20+ tools — no dev consoles, no pasted keys. Tokens stay on this computer.
onboarding.connectToolAbove: Connect a tool above with one click — or add them anytime later from the Connectors page.
onboarding.moreTools: 30+ more tools on the Connectors page — add or remove anytime. Tokens stay on this computer.
onboarding.automationDesc: A weekly digest, a morning brief — pick a template, running in two minutes.
onboarding.startWorkingDesc: Open a session and just ask — analyze files, draft, research, build.
onboarding.replaySetup: Replay this setup anytime: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Run setup again.

integrations.title: Connectors
integrations.connectorsSub: Apps and tools your coworkers can use. Connected ones come first.
integrations.mcpSub: External tool servers (stdio or HTTP), shared across all agents.

manageTabs.modelsDesc: Ticked models show in the composer's picker; the black badge marks the default for new sessions.
manageTabs.includedModelsDesc: Curated, agent-capable models this provider serves — add your key above to enable them.
manageTabs.pickerDesc: The models offered when starting a session; the black badge marks the default. Add more from a provider's card above.
manageTabs.defaultAlwaysShown: The default model is always shown — make another model default first
manageTabs.removeKeyConfirm: Remove the {{title}} key from this computer?
manageTabs.envNote: A key is set via OPENAI_API_KEY in this server's environment. You can override it above; the stored key is used only when the environment variable is absent.
manageTabs.mcpDesc: External tool servers (stdio or HTTP), shared across all agents. Enabled servers' tools are permission-gated. Changes apply to new sessions —
manageTabs.pasteObject: Paste a `{ "<name>": { … } }` object (or a full mcpServers block).
manageTabs.comingSoonDesc: One-click sign-in is coming soon — connect manually below for now:
manageTabs.signInUnlocks: Sign-in unlocks the one-click {{title}} connect — or connect manually below.
manageTabs.messagesFromSenders: Messages from senders you haven't allowed · {{count}}
manageTabs.noToolsYet: No tools for this connector yet.
manageTabs.noneYet: None yet — open a session's Sources ▸ Channels to subscribe it to a channel.
manageTabs.nobodyYet: nobody yet — Allow a recent sender →
manageTabs.noneYetMessage: None yet. Message the bot once and it'll show here.

personaView.unlockWorkflow: Declared by the persona — wire {{name}} into these to unlock its full workflow.
personaView.newSessionsDesc: When you start a {{name}} session these are enabled automatically. You can still mute any of them per session.
personaView.onByDefault: On by default for new sessions

personasTab.desc: Enable a coworker, then choose whether it appears in the new-session picker. The starred persona is the default for new sessions.
personasTab.disableWarning: Disabling archives its {{count}} conversation{{plural}} — they stay available under "Show archived".
personasTab.addDesc: Load from a local directory or a public GitHub repo. Files are copied into a managed area (a snapshot), so the persona stays stable even if the source changes. No code runs — a persona only composes vetted tools.
personasTab.installed: Installed {{count}} persona(s) — review and enable below.
personasTab.recommendedMode: Recommended mode: {{mode}}. Enable it above to use it.

gallery.title: Persona Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Curated coworkers · installs stay disabled until you approve them
gallery.signInTitle: Sign in to browse the Gallery
gallery.signInDesc: The Gallery is a curated set of coworkers from WeruBWorker Cloud and needs a (free) cloud sign-in. Installing personas from a folder or Git URL — on the Personas page — always works without an account.
gallery.unreachable: The gallery is unreachable right now — try again in a moment.
gallery.nothingTeam: Nothing shared with your team yet.
gallery.teamTeaser: From your team — nothing shared yet. Publishing a persona to your teammates is coming soon.
gallery.installedSuccess: Installed — it's waiting in Personas, disabled until you approve and enable it.
gallery.whatItCanDo: What it can do — verified from its manifest
gallery.manifestDesc: Read by this app's own parser, so it matches exactly what the install consent will ask you to approve. No executable code is installed.
gallery.connectYourself: You connect these yourself (one click when signed in) — installing the coworker grants it nothing until you do.

provider.testRuns: Runs one read-only check, then saves.
provider.noKeyOllama: No API key needed — Ollama runs models on this computer.

update.ready: WeruBWorker v{{version}} is ready to install.
update.error: The update couldn't be installed — it will be offered again next launch.

about.title: About
about.description: A local-first AI agent platform — provider-agnostic, privacy-respecting, extensible.
about.release_refactor: Architecture refactoring (modular connectors, mixin managers, context providers)
about.release_ollama: Ollama server integration with custom endpoint support
about.release_modelRoles: Dynamic model list with role labels from AI server
about.feature1: Multi-model support (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible servers, and more)
about.feature2: Local-first — your data never leaves your machine unless you choose
about.feature3: 25+ tool integrations (Slack, GitHub, Gmail, and more)
about.privacyDesc: All data stays on your computer. API keys are stored locally. No telemetry.
about.basedOnDesc: Based on OpenWorker (MIT License, github.com/andrewyng/openworker). Independently modified and extended.
